content: Lifestyle modifications, such as participating in stress reduction programs, quitting smoking, limiting alcohol consumption, and making dietary changes (e.g., avoiding caffeine, fatty foods, and certain spices), can enhance the effectiveness of this medication. If you miss a dose of this medication and are on a regular schedule, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature. It can also be refrigerated to improve its taste, but do not freeze it. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This medication is used to treat symptoms caused by excessive stomach acid, such as stomach upset, heartburn, and acid indigestion. Aluminum hydroxide, the active ingredient, is an antacid that works quickly to neutralize existing stomach acid. However, it does not prevent the production of acid. To use this medication, take it orally between meals and at bedtime. Follow the instructions on the product packaging or as directed by your doctor. Shake the bottle well before each dose. Refrigerating the suspension may improve its flavor, but do not freeze it. For optimal results, take this medication without other fluids. This product contains aluminum, which can interact with other medications (e.g., digoxin, iron, tetracycline antibiotics, pazopanib, and quinolone antibiotics like ciprofloxacin), potentially reducing their absorption. If your acid-related symptoms persist or worsen after one week of use, or if you suspect a serious medical issue, seek medical attention immediately. If you are using this medication daily for more than two weeks, consult your doctor, as you may have an underlying condition requiring alternative treatment. Common side effects include constipation, which can lead to complications such as hemorrhoids or bowel obstruction. To reduce the risk of constipation, stay hydrated and engage in regular physical activity. Using a magnesium-containing antacid alongside this product or taking stool softeners may also help. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, they have determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks. Aluminum-containing antacids can bind to phosphate in the gut, which may result in low phosphate levels, especially if used in high doses over a prolonged period and if kidney function is normal. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, if you experience symptoms such as difficulty breathing or loss of consciousness, seek emergency medical attention immediately. In the U.S., you can contact a poison control center at 1-800-222-1222 for overdose assistance. This document provides a summary of information about this medication and does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information tailored to your specific health needs.
